info.name: Lab 2 - Presentation (API Gateway)
info.description:
Run the folders in order, top to bottom. Gateway: http://localhost:8080 (stack started with `./deploy/setup-env.sh --demo` + `docker compose up`).
Before running: Collection -> Variables -> set adminKey to the ADMIN_KEY value from deploy/.env (only the admin requests need it).
Tokens and ids are saved automatically by each request.

item.name: 1. Gateway is up (Grades 1, 4)
item.description: The gateway answers on :8080 and sees all 8 services.

exec: pm.test("all 8 services up", () => { const s = pm.response.json().services; pm.expect(Object.keys(s)).to.have.length(8); Object.values(s).forEach(v => pm.expect(v).to.eql("up")); });

item.name: 2. Tokens (Grade 9)
item.description: Only the gateway issues and checks tokens. Login and register are the only public service routes.

item.name: Admin token with a wrong key -> 403
Login alice through Player Service (public route)
3. Authorization errors (Grade 9)
item.description: Rejected at the gateway; the services never see a token.

item.name: Service identity comes from the gateway (X-User-Id)
5. WebSocket negotiation (Grade 6)
item.description: The gateway only negotiates. Copy wsUrl from the first response, then New -> WebSocket -> paste -> Connect: the socket opens straight to Game on :3001.

exec: pm.test("points at Game :3001 with a token", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().wsUrl).to.match(/^ws:\/\/localhost:3001\/ws\?.*token=/));

item.name: Alice starts the exam (Exam -> gateway -> Player)
7. World + Zombie, and Game calling them (Grade 5)
Professor zombie -> exam starts (Game -> Zombie, Game -> Exam)
Alice's exams (the one the professor started)
